openrouter-api-key.label: OpenRouter API key
openrouter-api-key.helpText: OpenAI-compatible meta-provider. Used for AI tagging + sentiment. Encrypted at rest. Get one at openrouter.ai/keys.

llm-model.label: OpenRouter model slug
llm-model.helpText: Model identifier (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, openai/gpt-5-mini, google/gemini-2.5-flash). Defaults to claude-haiku-4.5 if blank.

llm-monthly-cost-cap-cents.label: Monthly LLM cost cap (USD cents)
llm-monthly-cost-cap-cents.helpText: Hard limit on AI spend per calendar month per installation. When exceeded, falls back to lexicon-only. Default $5.00 = 500 cents.

agent-whitelist.label: Verified agent usernames
agent-whitelist.helpText: One username per line. Pre-seeds the agent list on install.

taxonomy-json.label: Custom issue taxonomy (JSON)
taxonomy-json.helpText: Optional JSON array of {id,label,color}. Leave blank for defaults.

sentiment-threshold.label: Negative thread alert threshold
sentiment-threshold.helpText: Number of negative comments in a thread before mods get a modmail alert.

sla-minutes.label: First-response SLA (minutes)
sla-minutes.helpText: Posts unanswered by a verified agent beyond this threshold appear in the SLA breach feed.
